feature-main.text1: Hello and welcome to my website. My name is Stephan Mandl. I am a lawyer and software developer and on these pages you can find out more about me.
feature-main.text2: I specialize in cloud/platform engineering and DevOps as well as European data protection and IT law. My main interest is technological progress and the impact it has on society. I am interested in both the technical component and the attempt to tackle the negative effects through legislation.
feature-main.text3: If you would like to talk to me or have specific questions, please feel free to contact me. You can find the ways to get in contact on this page.

law.title: Law (Mag. iur.)
law.text: The traditional law degree in Austria ends with a degree equivalent to a Master's degree. I focused my studies on legal issues in the field of information technology which includes data protection law, telecommunications law, IP and IT law, e-commerce, internet and domain disputes and more.
